reasoning_traces.think:
The fantasy angle primitive operates as a structured probabilistic inference engine. It synthesizes player-level signals (usage, injury, pace, etc.) into a coherent narrative. The inference process begins with a Bayesian prior over fantasy outcomes, updated by observed signals. Each signal contributes a likelihood weight, forming a composite posterior. The contextual outlook shift primitive detects deviations from baseline expectations, triggered by evidence strength. Seasonal implications are derived from persistent signal patterns, modeled as time-series trends. The system avoids certainty language by maintaining probabilistic outputs. Dualities arise in how signals interact—e.g., high usage may offset injury risk. Failure modes include signal misalignment or overfitting to transient data. The GSE layer translates these into dynamic state transitions, while GSI ensures conformity to probabilistic norms.
